endpoints.name: Lead
endpoints.description: One lead by id. The include parameter inlines related records -- owner, creator, updater -- which are otherwise returned as bare ids.

endpoints.name: Leads
endpoints.description: Leads returned through a saved VIEW. Requires a view id -- and note the shape of this API: Freshsales has no plain 'all leads' listing, so every record set comes through a view, and Lead Filters is what lists the available view ids. The views are whatever the account's users created, so their names carry the organisation's own segmentation.

endpoints.name: Lead Filters
endpoints.description: The saved views available for leads, with their ids and names. THE PREREQUISITE for the leads listing, since that endpoint takes a view id and there is no default.

endpoints.name: Lead Fields
endpoints.description: Every field a lead can carry, standard and custom, with type and field group. The decoder for custom field keys, and the statement of what the account actually records about a lead.

endpoints.name: Lead Activites
endpoints.description: The activity timeline of one lead -- calls, emails, notes, status changes. Requires a lead id. The lead record carries its current state only, so this is the source for when it moved and who touched it.

endpoints.name: Contact
endpoints.description: One contact by id.

endpoints.name: Contacts
endpoints.description: Contacts through a saved view. Requires a view id, from Contact Filters. Same view-based access as leads. Note that in Freshsales a LEAD IS CONVERTED INTO A CONTACT, so the two tables hold different stages of the same people and counting both double-counts anyone converted.

endpoints.name: Contact Filters
endpoints.description: The saved views available for contacts.

endpoints.name: Contact Fields
endpoints.description: Every field a contact can carry, standard and custom.

endpoints.name: Contact Actvities
endpoints.description: The activity timeline of one contact. Requires a contact id.

endpoints.name: Account
endpoints.description: One sales account by id.

endpoints.name: Accounts
endpoints.description: Sales accounts -- the companies contacts belong to -- through a saved view. Requires a view id from Account Filters.

endpoints.name: Account Filters
endpoints.description: The saved views available for sales accounts.

endpoints.name: Account Fields
endpoints.description: Every field a sales account can carry.

endpoints.name: Deal
endpoints.description: One deal by id, with its stage and amount.

endpoints.name: Deals
endpoints.description: Deals through a saved view. Requires a view id from Deal Filters. The revenue pipeline: deals carry amount, expected close date, stage and probability, and the view determines which subset comes back.

endpoints.name: Deal Filters
endpoints.description: The saved views available for deals. Views here usually encode the pipeline stages the sales team actually works, so reading them is often faster than inferring the process.

endpoints.name: Deal Fields
endpoints.description: Every field a deal can carry, standard and custom.

endpoints.name: Task
endpoints.description: One task by id.

endpoints.name: Tasks
endpoints.description: Tasks, filtered by open, due today, overdue or completed. THE FILTER IS REQUIRED and there is no 'all' value, so a complete task set means several requests -- and an overdue count taken from the open filter alone will be wrong.

endpoints.name: Appointment
endpoints.description: One appointment by id.

endpoints.name: Appointments
endpoints.description: Appointments, filtered by past or upcoming. Required filter again, and the two are disjoint, so both are needed for a full picture.

endpoints.name: Sales Activity
endpoints.description: One sales activity by id.

endpoints.name: Sales Activities
endpoints.description: The logged sales activities -- calls, meetings and custom activity types -- across the account. The measure of selling effort, as opposed to the deals that resulted.

endpoints.name: Search
endpoints.description: Free-text search across users, leads, contacts, sales accounts and deals at once. Returns mixed record types told apart by their type field, so it is not a single-shape table.

endpoints.name: Lookup Search
endpoints.description: Searches ONE named field across chosen entities -- email or name. Narrower and more precise than the general search, and the right choice when matching a known identifier such as an email address.

endpoints.name: Files and Links
endpoints.description: The documents and links attached to one lead. Requires a lead id.
